_doc: Verbatim data-quality reconciliation of the deposited qc-zonage-norms-coaticook parquet, derived from the OFFICIAL source grilles (annexe A, sept. 2022 / sept. 2023) read as native text (pdftotext -layout) + word-bbox (pdftotext -tsv) column alignment, each value triple-cross-checked against already-served anchor values on the same page. Anti-invention: every value is a verbatim transcription of the cited source cell; a truly blank cell stays null. Fixes two systemic parser defects on this multi-page HORIZONTAL grille: (a) fabricated pseudo-zones from wrapped row-labels, (b) dropped/shift-corrupted hauteur columns.
remove: somme des marges de recul latérales min. (m)
_remove_doc: Fabricated pseudo-zones (norms=0): wrapped row-labels + stray numbers the parser mis-read as zone_codes. None matches any SIG zone number.
_rekey_doc: Mis-parsed real codes: the parser truncated the 'CONS' prefix (grp38 header 'CONSV1-814' wrapped across lines) and transposed HDB->HBD (grp45). Numeric bridge to the unique SIG code restores the real code; the CONS rows keep their already-correct verbatim norms.
